column1: # qdistro test registry — PILOT (partial, NOT yet enforced)
# A central, machine-readable inventory of selected qdistro tests. This is
# a deliberately SMALL pilot subset (see todo/levitateos/
# nixos-testing-synthesis.md item 5): it does NOT yet cover every test, is
# NOT consulted by qci for selection, and skips/blocked are NOT yet enforced
# against it. The goal of the pilot is to validate the column schema against
# a handful of real, hand-inspected tests before expanding it.
# Consistency is checked by `qci registry-check` (verifies each path exists
# and each gate is one qci knows). Lines starting with '#' and blank lines
# are ignored. Columns are TAB-separated.
# Columns:
#   path             repo-relative path to the test (from qdistro repo root)
#   gate             qci gate that runs it: host | bats | gui | image | vm-smoke
#   isolation_tier   none | host | vm | vm-nested  (execution isolation needed)
#   required_services VM/system services that must be live; 'none' for pure host
#   network          none | loopback | external
#   agent_or_ocr     none | ocr | agent  (needs OCR or an LLM agent runner)
#   owner_component  the source component this test guards
#   slow_or_flaky    no | slow | flaky | slow,flaky
